headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after Chinese spy and affair scandal, replaced by CFO
summary: China's intelligence service reportedly recruited an AI executive to get close to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted an affair with her. Nvidia opened a board investigation, Congress summoned Huang, and shareholders sued. A second affair, with a subordinate, was then reported, and Huang resigned; CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO. Trump proposed Tim Cook as a successor and said the FBI was investigating. Huang agreed to testify before Congress.
